notes.title: Playtest Version 1.0.18 Update
notes.notes:
New Features
The arena has added a leaderboard (it will only be listed after the update when challenging the Infinity Tower).

Press ctrl+ 'to bring up the console. Enter: ‘cleartower’ to reset the number of floors in the Infinity Tower
Adjustment
The Gem Bag in the Backpack can be used all at once by holding ctrl and then right-clicking

Meow Meow Rabbit's ability has been changed to a new ability: Purification
Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where AFK battles would cause memory leaks.

Fixed a bug where completing non-main quest adventure maps would incorrectly complete main story Hell quests.

notes.title: Playtest Version 1.0.16 Update
notes.notes:
New Features
 Added 10x Draw option to the Jenin Merchant’s Random Eggs 


Bug Fixes
Fixed a refinement effect bug: The effect was incorrectly preventing damage every round, instead of only the first round of battle as intended.

Fixed an issue where some refinement effects were not triggering.

Fixed instances where combat would occasionally freeze.

Fixed a bug where the Jenin list in the Jenin Lodge would not refresh after refining Jenin.

notes.title: v1.0.15 Playtest Update
notes.notes:
New
 Added Encyclopedia pages for BUFFs and Equipment Refinement.


 Added equipment lock function to prevent dismantling and selling.



 Added Jenin talent lock function: Using Talent Scrolls will not replace locked talents, and each evolution grants 1 lock slot.

Optimization/Adjustments
 High-quality limited-time quests now grant extra rewards (Refinement Potions, Parchments, Potential Fruits).


 Disabled battle reward pop-up notifications.


 Jenin can now be allocated stat points from the Team interface.


 The Jenin Lodge now displays equipped gear comparison when viewing items. 



 Changed "Release" to "Batch Refine"; refining Jenin now grants experience.


Bug Fixes
 Fixed an issue where upgrading a Jenin directly to Level 10 would prevent completion of the "Upgrade Jenin to Level 5" quest.


 Fixed a bug where combat and gear crafting data from old saves persisted in new saves when switching archives.

notes.title: v1.0.14 Playtest Update
notes.notes:
New / Optimizations
 Added Jenin filtering function to the Jenin Lodge and Team interface.


 Added manual refresh function to the Shop and Jenin Merchant.


 Hunting time in the Hunting Lodge is now related to the quality and level of dispatched Jenin.


 Added an Abandon function for Time-Limited Quests.


 Infinity Tower cap in the Playtest version has been changed to 200 floors.

Fixes / Adjustments
Fixed an issue where pressing ESC during initial Jenin selection would hide the interface, preventing selection.


 Fixed a bug where talent icons overlapped during initial Jenin selection.


Fixed an issue where clicking the "Complete" button was ineffective when finishing the Dreamy Meadow (Hell) quest.


 Fixed inconsistent line breaks in quest descriptions.


 Fixed incorrect stat bonuses in the Heavenly Thunder skill description.


 Fixed an issue where Jenin equipment locks were not displayed correctly.


 Fixed a bug in the Blacksmith where crafting scrolls incorrectly showed a requirement to clear 0 floors of the Infinity Tower



 Fixed a bug where time-limited quests incorrectly displayed the wrong scroll type.
